notes.title: Update v.1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

It’s been a little while since our last update, but today we’re excited to bring you a new patch featuring user-requested features and key bug fixes.
Thanks as always for your continued feedback and support!


▼ New Features & System Adjustments
We’ve implemented several improvements including full controller support, double speed toggle, and more visibility during battles:

- Added controller support.
- Characters who retreated (HP hit 0) will now still gain experience after a victory.
- Implemented keybind customization options (gamepad not supported).
- Added a “2x Speed” toggle to battle speed options.
- Added a “Squad Details” screen accessible during battles to check unit stats and passive skills.


▼ Bug Fixes & Additional Tweaks
- The Options menu now includes descriptions for each difficulty level at any time.
- Fixed an issue where certain tutorial images became overly pixelated at medium or low graphical settings.
- Fixed a line in the “Unite Episode” between Rubeus and Sapphirus where dialogue meant for Rubeus was mistakenly assigned to Sapphirus.
- Corrected a translation error in “Let's take a look!” where “Duke” was incorrectly displayed as “Baron.”
- In the Squad menu (bottom right), unit names will now auto-adjust spacing when name length exceeds the frame.
- Fixed an issue where only Scarlet and Lily were shown in the unit name display, now all ally units are shown.
- Long comments shown on the top-right of the main screen will now auto-adjust if they exceed the space.


▼ Playable Demo at TGS 2025!
We’re thrilled to announce that “The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily” will be playable at Tokyo Game Show 2025!

Thank you so much for all the encouragement and support! This opportunity wouldn’t have been possible without you.

If you’re attending, be sure to visit the One or Eight booth and give it a try!
Other Alliance Arts titles will also be featured so please look forward to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6ba01b6b57831436d469fb042509a058c0e7e99f.png

We’re deeply committed to improving the game based on your feedback and growing it into something even better.
Thank you for continuing to support The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!

notes.title: Update v.1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Since the launch of the full version, an incredible number of players have played the game, and we’ve been featured as one of the top releases of July 2025.
The entire team is deeply encouraged by this, and it’s all thanks to your warm feedback and support.
We sincerely thank you!

We’re carefully reading all your posts and reviews on the Community Hub, as well as livestreams and videos on social media and various platforms.
(We’re sure Lady Scarlet herself is watching your streams and smiling…!)

Today, we’d like to report on several bug fixes and balance adjustments.


▼ Fixes and Game Adjustments
We received a lot of feedback about the enemies in the final act.
The goal was to create a structure where Scarlet and her allies grow stronger together to overcome overwhelmingly powerful enemies.
However, to enable smoother gameplay, we’ve made slight balance adjustments:

・Increased the number of followers gained after each battle in the final act
・Increased the number of followers gained after the speech event

By increasing public support faster, you can benefit from things like:
“higher starting MP in command battles” & “stronger forces in delegated battles.”
Skills that scale with follower count will also be more useful.

Examples:
- Scarlet’s passive skill “Crimson Banner” now heals more HP
- Lily’s EX skill “On the Stage” now has higher stun success rate
- Scarlet & Lily’s Unison Skill “Hold Me to Thy Bosom” now stuns more reliably

We’ve also made a few other fixes and adjustments:

・Minor animation tweaks to the Prologue tutorial battle
・In Act 2, simply unlocking the bypass route incorrectly triggered the “Great Wall detour” branch — this now happens only when you reach the bypass outpost


▼ Bug Fixes & Optimization

Thank you for your patience. We’ve also carried out bug fixes and optimization.

- Revised memory management to reduce memory usage during gameplay
- Improved loading time when loading save data
- Fixed a progression-blocking issue where units could be placed beyond outpost capacity when Sanjay and Carmine or Primula and Jane joined simultaneously
- Fixed a bug where getting stunned before counterattacking in battle caused no damage and softlocked the game
- Fixed a UI bug where pressing multiple menu buttons at once on the main screen broke the layout
- Fixed issue in some enemy commander defeat scenarios where stats-up dialogs failed to advance
- Fixed an issue where backgrounds did not darken properly during skill enhancement scenes for some enemy commanders
- Fixed a delay in visual effects disappearing when switching from 3D to 2D maps
- Removed unintended frame rate cap settings from language/difficulty options during initial launch
- Fixed incorrect effect positioning for Scarlet & Primula’s Unison skill
- Fixed display issues with ground contact and effects for Uisce & Carmine’s bond skill
- Fixed incorrect camera positioning for Sanjay & Carmine’s Unison Skill
- Fixed temporary narrow FOV bug after Nicol’s panic scene when supply lines are threatened in Act 1
- Replaced the incorrect video for Strategy Dogma “Unit Movement II”
- Fixed Almeria’s skill “Here's the Truth” which stunned for 3 turns instead of the intended 1 turn
- Adjusted line spacing and other typography issues in Simplified Chinese
- Minor fixes to various localized text



We plan to continue releasing multiple updates for the full version, aiming for around September.
However, as we’re concentrating our resources on full version development, the differences with the demo version have become significant.

As a result, we have decided to end public availability of the demo version in order to focus fully on the full version.
We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback via the Community Hub, reviews, or our official Discord!
(Of course, content creation is also welcome!)

Thank you again for your continued support of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!

notes.title: Director's Message: A guide for playing the game
notes.content:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Thank you so much for waiting...
We’re so happy to announce that we have finally released the full version of the game.
This is entirely thanks to the warm feedback and countless messages of support we’ve received from all of you. We are deeply grateful from the bottom of our hearts.

Today, to mark the release of the full version, we’d like to take the time to once again highlight the game’s features and points of interest.


▼ Capture every enemy Commanders or Execute them!
The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game where you lead the small rebel force the "Scarlet Army" in a daring challenge against the overwhelming might of the Empire.

Victory in this uphill battle depends on one thing: infiltrating enemy territory swiftly and capturing or defeating enemy commanders.
This isn’t a game where brute force always wins the day. Instead, your success depends on devising strategies to outmaneuver the enemy using your limited forces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c3ced6fbd8d293363f5c2963dd67ac6da4393508.jpg

Will you capture every enemy commander and recruit them to your cause to clear Scarlet’s name from the false accusation of assassinating the emperor?

Or will you slaughter the commanders without hesitation, staining your hands with blood as you march toward the path of a Demon Queen?

We will be breaking down the gameplay system of the upcoming full version of the game, and explain some of the elements that may help you in experiencing this strategy game.


▼Build Supply Lines Against the Empire
A key element of this game’s mechanics is the concept of “supply lines.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8100ef2cab716c0661eaa87985a6cb70aa58209a.gif

- Lines that connect your Headquarters to your occupied outposts are called supply lines.
- Units stationed on supply lines automatically receive healing (supplies) each turn.

This lets you prepare offensives, hold out in long battles, and adapt your strategy as needed.

As long as an outpost is connected to the Head Quarter, it will recover each turn, 
meaning it is absolutely critical for the Scarlet Army's survival to maintain supply lines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2e5d9f8b31d64badd2b6d73e058f0b6195777ea3.jpg

In other words, this game is all about connecting, extending, and defending supply lines to defeat enemy commanders.

Since the enemy has their own supply lines too, battles become a contest of how to preserve your lines while severing theirs.

This ongoing struggle over supply lines is one of the core tactical systems in the game.


▼ You can’t protect everything... So what will you do?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/98f632da523502d9039edaa4aea19382cce892cd.jpg
You’re constantly outnumbered. 
As your influence spreads, it becomes impossible to defend every outpost.
This is the harsh reality Scarlet faces as the leader of a rebel army.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1bb32af8d80eb362584401cd6b989c4018b688a2.jpg

As you see here, you cannot defend all of the supply lines when being attacked from all sides...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/57f9821c0c1eaa65a0a451b3a46c82f66e1e0cfa.gif

But Scarlet has one powerful advantage. The Stream Airship and Shows.

These allow for powerful strategic effects across the map:
- Stall enemy movement
- Disrupt enemy supply lines
- Boost friendly unit mobility
- Lure enemies into traps
- Flip enemy bases to your side

Use these effects to manipulate enemy movement and secure your supply routes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e4e83b15ca042b831da71b5e628b850a81ef695f.jpg

Also, Scarlet and Lily will stream all kinds of bizarre, fun shows from the stream airship, spreading propaganda to shake the morale of enemy troops!


▼ A War of Lines, Not Land
Bases are not your territory, but just a line for supplies
(There’s no policy management of sorts in this game)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/525e45673becc9a7d3cdd7a33c4b10f676b91cb4.jpg

Instead of expanding territory indiscriminately, your best bet is to spearhead a direct supply line to your target commander and force a short-term decisive battle.
That’s how the outnumbered Scarlet Army finds a fighting chance against the Empire.

Your tactical choices—which outposts to hold or abandon, who to assign as the strike teams—is the heart of gameplay.

Anticipate enemy movements, abandon unnecessary posts, and rebuild supply lines to focus fire on the next commander.

This game is not about conquest but a game about strategically capturing or eliminating key targets.


▼ Delegate (auto-battle) or Command Battle: Your Choice
The game progresses taking turns between the enemy phase and the player phase. When you make contact with an enemy unit, the battle begins.

Enemy turns can be sped up for smoother pacing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/192414ee2a652acb5a96b3a67aa01eb09b664b0f.jpg

When a battle begins, you can choose to Delegate (auto-battle) or use Commands (player input)

Before the battle begins, you'll see a projected damage preview for both sides.
If the expected losses look too high for Delegate, you can take direct command to mitigate risk.
(Note: Auto-battle uses only standard attacks and does not trigger special skills.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4dac59b38f4775a4a1f6359ff03d76f9d98b3059.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/16b3999b86c7fecb222c820c06173d84e7349636.gif

If you take direct control, battles play out in a three-turn command battle system.

Each character learns and upgrades skills (tactics) with RPG-like progression.
As your army grows, what you can do in three turns also expands.

Because of the three-turn limit, battles against powerful bosses may not be resolved in a single engagement.

That’s where wave attacks using multiple units in succession come into play. 
Who goes in, and in what order, becomes a core strategic decision.

You’ll also find growth and character relationship mechanics, including:
- Leveling up from victories
- Upgrading your unit size at certain levels
- Building "trust" between units that fight together repeatedly

Build enough trust between units, and you’ll unlock special “Unison Skills” and character-specific "Unite Episode".

Befriend (capture) various commanders and enjoy building your own troops.


▼ Troop Count and Damage Output
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9b03ec3952c56850419485c6290e68566e98da63.jpg
In this game, each character takes on the role of a unit commander, leading their own squad into battle.

Because of this, as their HP (horde points) decreases, the damage they deal also drops, making it harder to achieve results.

That’s why maintaining strong supply lines and entering battle in peak condition is key to victory for the Scarlet Army.

On the flip side, this also means cutting off enemy supplies and chipping away at their HP will weaken their attacks in turn.

Sever the enemy’s supply lines, and engage their commanders when your forces are at full strength —
Pave your own path to victory with the tactics of a true battlefield strategist!


▼ What fate awaits the two…?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c05ebb81653c0d594c16dde2516cbb8ff6ca1e6f.jpg
This game is multi-ending.

Will Scarlet and Lily choose to capture every enemy commander and bring them over to their side, in order to clear their names of the alleged emperor’s assassination?

Or will they cast aside all allegations and destroy the Empire themselves, without making a single ally?

There are a few other endings as well, but at its core, your choice to capture all or reject them entirely will greatly impact the fate of the two protagonists.
For your first playthrough, we recommend aiming to either capture everyone or execute everyone, as that will let you fully enjoy the story.

Also, depending on how and when you capture or execute each enemy commander, the characters' reactions and events will change in subtle ways.

Most of the story (including dialogue scenes) unfolds as a fully voiced drama, so if you enjoy the world, we hope you to try different choices!
(No matter how you play, the story will always move forward so not to worry!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bae9df67cb8fdc339ccd6003e40b1574b74f4b6a.jpg

If you’re aiming to capture a specific commander, be sure to check their info screen. Capture conditions are listed in the enemy information, and you can plan your strategy accordingly.

Also, as mentioned in the previous story overview, Scarlet and Lily are a fixed couple in this game.
(Sorry, there are no branching romance options based on choices)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8f87f83011187d08400b1db851eb8dbee07d1950.gif

Instead, the game features a system where certain characters can build trust by fighting and winning together, gradually raising their “Trust Level.”

As Trust Levels grow, the pair will unlock special story episodes (Unite Episode) that explore their unique relationship, and may even learn powerful Unison Skills.

We hope you enjoy building relationships between your units and watching them grow together!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8b2b865945441a3d1f649938ef118c837c808daa.jpg

Each character has two Unite Episode partners, and these combinations are listed in the character menu.
(If you try enough, it's possible to view all episodes without replaying the game)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/80b85022e6af956357db513a6a17ad76f0e34d47.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/cd65022d4e327d4c9ded8f796de9a34581c9d83f.gif

As you progress through these Unite Episodes, powerful Unison Skills will also be unlocked.


▼ Want a smoother experience?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8258b932da86c627a9f7bf097138c5dca7fc6ecf.png

When you first start the game, or anytime from the options menu, you can freely change the difficulty.

Strategy Mode
　　A tactical challenge for those who enjoy carefully planning their moves. Great for players familiar with strategy games.

Easy Mode
A mode designed for those who don’t usually play strategy games, with toned-down enemy stats.

There are no differences in content between difficulty modes, so we hope you’ll choose the one that feels most comfortable for you!



We hope this deep dive has been helpful!
(Sorry it got a bit long again…!)

The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily isn’t your typical land-expanding strategy game.
It’s a strategy game focused on supply lines, and about a small rebel force facing off a massive imperial army.

What kind of battle will Scarlet and Lily fight, and how will their journey end?

Will they find a happy ending, or become feared as Demon Queens——

Our biggest joy would be for everyone to see the good ending of these two with your own eyes.

Please guide Scarlet and Lily to a happy ending!

We hope for your continued support for
『The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily』

notes.title: Demo Strategy Guide
notes.content:
The Great Strategy Guide (Act 1)Act 1 Overview
Act I's objective is to capture three enemy generals. This guide breaks the Act down into three key steps, each focused on capturing one target.



➤ Step 1: Advance along the eastern route and capture the first enemy general, Uisce.

➤ Step 2: Move north from Uisce’s base, then circle west to capture the second general, Nicol.

➤ Step 3: Head north from Nicol’s position. While holding off powerful enemy forces, capture the final general, Geena.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9046c1a6a4910f6767d65b4a47aaa86e8de3ab6f.png"]
The Great Strategy Step 1: From Battle Start to Uisce's Encounter\[ Basic Strategy ]
In Step 1, we will go through the game’s core tactics. The key is to reach the enemy general while maintaining your supply lines, either by stalling or avoiding powerful enemies along the way.

The main objective here is to capture Uisce. While there is a more direct route, it’s guarded by a powerful enemy unit. Taking a detour will be the safer approach.


① Take the Detour Route to the Right
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/790e3d7d2b021ddb2cdaf6bd065d447f4caf2c8a.png"]

➤ Avoid heading directly south, the path is blocked by a powerful enemy unit, so taking the longer route around would be safer.

➤ Keep Scarlet and Lily together as a team.



After moving one tile to the top right, enemy forces stationed at the outpost (mountain road) will begin advancing toward the base you just left.

On the following turn, return to Dahmlin (your previous position) and take it back.

This will trigger an event where you’re “surrounded and unable to move,” after which you’ll gain access to the Stream Airship.


② Move the Stream Airship to the Arrow
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3775c38b721261eefb33b9517e84669a535ef62a.jpg"]

Follow the tutorial instructions to move the Stream Airship. There’s a position where you can stall two bases at once (since the airship’s stall effect can target multiple bases simultaneously, this is a great chance to practice).


③ Battles Along the Way
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/771473e654337f8ff271048f5199f82ab96c1e8c.jpg"]

In small battles before the boss fight, Scarlet’s army generally has the upper hand.

Though, preserving HP is crucial, so rather than always using the Delegate combat, commanding battles yourself for better outcomes is recommended.



➤ Scarlet’s AOE skill “Crimson Wave” is excellent for wiping out enemies.

➤ Use Lily’s “Opening Call” to boost the defense of allies who are likely to be attacked.



When a base has 2 or more durability (★), you can't advance until you reduce all stars. One ★ is reduced per turn, so capturing a 2★ base takes two turns. 


④ Switch to Capture Stream
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a43e63409c09af1706814c86057d2009529fdc23.jpg"]

Once you’ve captured the base in front of Uisce’s, switch the Stream Airship to Capture Stream and advance your units.

During this time, you won’t be able to stall enemies, so it’s possible that enemy forces will infiltrate your bases like Dahmlin. But don’t worry, as long as you capture Uisce, you’ll win the map.

Since Capture Stream consumes no energy, keep it active as you move in to capture Uisce.


⑤ The Battle Against Uisce
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bed2f5c80fdaab9652a9e618aec51c17b4c51884.jpg"]

Uisce is a powerful infantry, which has an advantage over Scarlet who is a cavalry unit.



➤ Use Lily’s “Opening Call” to boost Scarlet’s defense, and focus on dealing damage using “Crimson Wave,” which doesn’t trigger counterattacks.

➤ It’s fine if you can’t defeat him in one battle, recover HP via supply lines and use Scarlet’s “Crimson Among Men” skill to sustain.



Once Uisce’s HP turns red and “Capture!” appears under the name, use Lily’s skill “On the Stage” to capture her.


⑥ Using Uisce as an Ally
Uisce is a high-crit character with a powerful EX skill that deals major damage to single targets.

➤ EX Skill: "Fox Hunting"

・A powerful 1.8x single-target damage.

・Deals a guaranteed extra 200 damage. A reliable damage source.

➤ “Updated Observations”

・Increases the attack power of allied units.

➤ “Hometown Hero”

・While limited to Elysia, it speeds up base occupation by 1.

➤ “Guerrilla Warfare”

・On turn 3, boosts crit damage for allied infantry and artillery.

・Can create synergy with ally units.


The Great Strategy Step 2: Capturing Nicol\[ Basic Strategy ]
Step 2 features Nicol as the enemy general. With Uisce joining your army, you’ll now be able to advance with 3 units.

Hold the frontline with Uisce while Scarlet and Lily flank from the side to cut off enemy supply lines.


① Move Uisce Near Nicol’s Base
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6aada11d48141201fa2a7fa4b2d3e9e1dff7ce08.png"]

After capturing Uisce, turns continue. If Scarlet and Lily already acted during his capture, only Uisce can move.

Send Uisce near Nicol’s base.

Nicol won’t initiate combat against Uisce, so have Uisce hold the line while Scarlet and Lily advance along a detour.


② Flank With Scarlet and Lily to Sever Supply Lines
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/563a9efecbba30db9b892f974326ec30a666a7e9.png"]

While Uisce holds the frontline, move Scarlet and Lily along the marked path to cut off enemy supplies.

You can rush straight to the next base or capture bases along the way and increase their durability (★).　

Some small enemy units will target Uisce, so you could use this to farm experience and level up.


③ A.C.E.
Arriving at the Elysia Customs Gate triggers an event. A powerful enemy unit called "A.C.E." spawns at Geena’s base.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9c11314cbc2d57e110f774f62a1d6cc6b357e677.png"]

A.C.E. patrols a specific route and won’t advance toward Nicol’s position, so ignore it for now.


④ Head South and Capture Nicol
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3dfc121b45d131d49f3a8b9a67bd3729d1796f91.jpg"]

While heading south, stall weaker enemies coming from the north and advance to Nicol’s base.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9e1db06ac7014aa8f757f02aceea2f1e60cd2763.jpg"]

Nicol is a strong infantry commander, so he has an edge over Scarlet. Use “Opening Call” to strengthen Scarlet’s defenses.

Nicol will use skills to reduce your party’s defense and mobility at the start of battle. If you’re fighting a group, Scarlet’s “Crimson Wave” is great for damaging them all at once.

Meanwhile, have Lily who has advantage against infantry, focus on steadily chipping away Nicol’s HP.

Even if you can’t win in one go, two to three battles should push Nicol’s HP into the red.


⑤ Capture Nicol Using the Stream Airship
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ba3b6a64a34ae83e2634170e822a5172f486156d.jpg"]

When Nicol is weakened, move the Stream Airship over his base and switch to Capture Stream to capture him.

In some cases, you may capture her while defending a base.

But this is only possile if Capture Stream is active on that tile. 



Even if you capture Nicol, he will only join you as a unit AFTER you capture Geena. Time you attacks and try to acquire both characters.


The Great Strategy Step: Capturing Geena\[ Basic Strategy ]
The key in the Geena fight is avoiding A.C.E.

Understand its movement pattern and use Stalling Stream wisely to gain the upper hand.

Here’s the general route after the Nicol fight. If enemies have occupied other bases, you could reclaim them before heading to Geena, if you want.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1858a6bfc83e0b564ba4b2465ee112dbb422792c.png"]


① Stall A.C.E. and Move Toward Geena’s Base
A.C.E. patrols four bases in a clockwise loop and only attacks if the player's unit is in its way.

Take the northern, U-shaped route to Geena’s position.

If you can stall A.C.E. at Position ① on the map below, you can easily attack Geena's base.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9c11314cbc2d57e110f774f62a1d6cc6b357e677.png"]


Tips: Do I need to fight A.C.E.?
A.C.E. offers boss-level EXP, but they are extremely strong.

Early in the game, your forces are too weak to reliably defeat it, so it’s not necessary to fight them.


② The Battle Against Geena
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e932e5b7e4963888774b6a88b0719e9d67a84f40.jpg"]

Geena is an artillery unit who buffs enemy defense and debuffs the player's attack. Her passive also reduces cavalry attack and mobility on turn 1—bad news for Scarlet.

She is backed by three escort units and is difficult to capture in one battle.

Use Scarlet’s “Crimson Wave” in the first two turns to eliminate small fry, then target Geena on turn 3.

Support her with other allies for best results.

Use Uisce’s “Updated Observations” to boost Scarlet’s power further.

When Geena’s HP is red, move the Stream Airship and capture her.


Out of Stream Airship Energy?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9c11314cbc2d57e110f774f62a1d6cc6b357e677.png"]If the battle against Geena drags on and you can no longer stall A.C.E., time your moves and circle back clockwise.

Make sure to always stall A.C.E. at Position ① only.

notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

The Great Prologue is a series that introduces the enemy commanders that stand in the way of Scarlet and her allies. 
Today, we’re taking a closer look at characters who also appeared in the previous demo.
(We're currently working on a new updated demo and we appreciate your patience.)

The people introduced here are among the first characters Scarlet will encounter.
Just who are they?

Now then, Lady Scarlet, Lily-chan, take it away!


▼ The Ambitious Baroness
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/039a0257475a00e47ab8d9e03694b8dab70900a5.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/86d193f16d1cdf6ac8d2ce23979ddea381f657bd.png
Baron's are little too common to meet.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7a7b1c92f95c0966679d643cc4e7eea7c7775581.png
Ugh, upper nobility.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
Well... That’s just how an aristocratic society works.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
Guess we’ll be relying on the cue cards from here on.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c55d447859473f1ef7d8db2f9f6add639f1a3101.png
Not my preference, but fine. Still... that outfit is a fashion crime.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
Apparently she fancies herself a fashion leader.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a54fb421780d063523b46d35fc2597f6a40ffba7.png
... This?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
Well… she definitely has a unique sense of style.
And, being a baron, her title isn’t exactly at the top.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Which means, if she’s been appointed Governor-general with that rank, 
she must be highly competent.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Yeah, it implies as much.
Though it doesn’t look like she’s happy with that status.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
...A true ambitious type.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png
Would we want her on our side?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a0a88f4bed50dad85595a0e8974ff444b86473e7.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Wow, she’s impressive.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7b409f3a8778cf91b2d2b52427e700596b567f87.png
Spreading debuffs with smoke while unleashing artillery on everyone?
That’s power befitting the Governor of Elysia.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
And that defense! 
Just... ignore the fashion.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b8c8d00ef665dd082352239b7e6119adec3cb55e.png
Fashion doesn’t affect combat capability.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
She apparently graduated top of her artillery class at the military academy.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/86d193f16d1cdf6ac8d2ce23979ddea381f657bd.png
Can’t judge a book by its cover.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Especially in the male-dominated Empire, 
where being a female baron is pretty rare.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b7d58c80b12f3a802087f6e706d2060f109858b5.png


▼ The Professional Soldier Supporting the Baroness
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8103f327ad905be8bb099a11942b9e1ab51a28fe.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b8c8d00ef665dd082352239b7e6119adec3cb55e.png
Well, well...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Now that’s a straight-laced officer.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/cce63bc4aa1a7605481965edae37f4ca3a5fefaf.png
He seems... painfully boring.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
That's incredibly rude.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png
Let’s see… childhood friend of the baroness?
And also a baron?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Now Lady Scarlet is reading the cue cards, eh!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/f73949adbc357583976de28a51035891af5a2241.png
Hey, I don’t know this guy.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Is it strange to have the same title as her?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
It’s rare. 
Noble society has strict hierarchies.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
So serving as her adjutant is his personal choice?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4c51645be8fa9f470b8709c62112e6dd3a23f140.png
...That’s what it sounds like.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
That Empire vibe is showing for sure.
So... maybe he’s her favorite?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png
Likely.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png
...You realize, Lady Scarlet, if we try to tear apart a duo this tightly bonded...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
They would go ballistic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1433dbc3656455c19a20f020fd2abbf7df9a047b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
What’s this? A crossbow bolt?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Close, it’s a flechette. 
Developed for use in firearms and artillery.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
...Are these even accurate?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
Not particularly. 
They lack rifling stability.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Ah, so they’re meant to scatter. 
But he’s on foot?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7b409f3a8778cf91b2d2b52427e700596b567f87.png
They’re used in rifles and shotguns.
High anti-personnel lethality. 
They stay in the body; more hits, more damage.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8354495730e29fad1b1c26700fb676822460e41a.png
He’s shouting “Don't die!” while literally shooting people...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b8c8d00ef665dd082352239b7e6119adec3cb55e.png
It’s possible to be dutiful and kind at the same time.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
Working is hard…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0121a5b22ad546fade8a187de66933f48dda96c2.png


▼ The Anti-Empire Boy Sniper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/51d1945165ca8efd3c27a2d56aba48d1152a2c08.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png
His file’s pretty thin...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
He’s apparently the leader of a resistance in Elysia, 
one of the Empire’s colonies.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png
The only Elysian we’ve seen so far.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
I’m from the Republic too, you know.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Technically different from the Empire as a whole, sure. 
But this isn’t a competition.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
Apparently, he’s also a master whisky blender with an excellent nose.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
Wait, could he have blended the Elysian whisky I drank?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
Only one way to find out.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/f73949adbc357583976de28a51035891af5a2241.png
...Now I really want him on our side.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7a7b1c92f95c0966679d643cc4e7eea7c7775581.png
Don’t choose people just for their booze!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/69a873eb7eebf55956b788387f53869e0fe2d375.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a54fb421780d063523b46d35fc2597f6a40ffba7.png
Ow!!!!!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Calm down. 
You weren’t actually hit, Lady Scarlet.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b8c8d00ef665dd082352239b7e6119adec3cb55e.png
Oh, right. 
I’m the commander.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8ceb9019ecc30e998c9238e4e35594036ec546c9.png
Sniper’s got a huge single-target burst damage.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7b409f3a8778cf91b2d2b52427e700596b567f87.png
He’s the kind you keep on reserve until the perfect moment.
Very dangerous as an enemy.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
You’re cavalry, Lady Scarlet…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Worst possible matchup.
Though your unit's not faring much better…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
...Sorry for being squishy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/13cffce1aad303c88d111dd0f22bc2656e72dca5.png



Thank you, both of you!

Up to now, we’ve introduced a wide array of enemy commanders and characters.
Whether you recruit them or ignore the suspicion from the world and rebel with just Scarlet and Lily.
We hope you’ll enjoy discovering what fate awaits them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2c68b4939f591a74fd207b0a8452542dbdb676b9.png
(If recruited, Gina can disrupt enemy forces via broadcast!)


From the next episode, we want to summarize key changes made for the full release, 
and highlight how to enjoy the game more smoothly.
Answering questions like:

- So, what kind of game is this anyway?
- Any tips on gameplay?
We hope to convey the uniqueness of this strategy simulation game more clearly.

We will have to make you wait a little more, but we hope you look forward to the game!
Thank you again for you support for The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

notes.content:
Hello!
This is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Many characters appear in front of Scarlet and her allies. Some stand in the way and some stand alongside...
In this edition of “The Great Prologue,”  Lady Scarlet and Lily-chan will be introducing the colorful cast of characters from the Empire.

We’ve greatly increased the amount of voiced lines compared to the demo, and hope to deliver a more immersive story.
 (*It’s not fully voiced, but they do talk quite a bit... I think!)
We’d be delighted if you imagine their voices and look forward to your encounters with them.

Now then—
Lady Scarlet and Lily-chan, take it away!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/27a6cc8fa869267bbb11c493eb12fc0e3937772d.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png
Hm? A non-combatant?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b8c8d00ef665dd082352239b7e6119adec3cb55e.png

Wow, that’s rare these days.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
I wonder how close she is with Lord Gwyn?

 and other times acts as an advisor for policy-making.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
Sounds like they’re really close.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4c51645be8fa9f470b8709c62112e6dd3a23f140.png
He’s such a stick-in-the-mud though…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/26d1367eb359f0846f5d240d842537f9ebb6b55d.png

Emmmmmmmm

 What exactly do the Police Corps do?

Hurts more when it’s us getting hit.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7b409f3a8778cf91b2d2b52427e700596b567f87.png
That’s the military police for you... Relentless.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2026145c0260718f0ee84c4197b05bc009156d24.png
I wonder if the other officer is just as tough…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
That’s the other twin.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2026145c0260718f0ee84c4197b05bc009156d24.png
No... Scary.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Together, they’re Gwyn’s sword and shield.
This one’s the sword; aggressive and throws out debuffs. Nasty combo.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png
 I'm already not looking forward to the next one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8832da5beea82aa45a58b9cba85db0043de91fad.png


▼ Beautiful Vice Commander of the Police Corps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2feb6e162d57e3a06480c572e8ad0d651d84a005.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2026145c0260718f0ee84c4197b05bc009156d24.png
Wait whaaaaat?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
It’s just the same face, calm down.
Unlike Sapphirus, she’s calm and reasonable.
Though her intuition is pretty sharp.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Still scary.
…But she sure acts cute around Gwyn.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
She does have a lady's side.
I haven’t really felt disliked from her, now that I think about it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Oh? Was she kind to you?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4c51645be8fa9f470b8709c62112e6dd3a23f140.png
She did give me an incredibly disappointed look once.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
…That might be worse than being hated.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png
Her brother guards Gwyn’s immediate vicinity, while she handles incident investigations.
They split their duties.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
She’s young, but seems earnest—feels responsible for her position, 
and is well-trusted by her subordinates…
What a hard-working person.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
She’s truly Gwyn's right hand.
Her investigation logs are neat, 
and she personally organizes files too.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
…She might have a rough past.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/092852cf02b1a3b6f2023a0abf8c22aeef90f3dc.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
A hardcore supporter-type.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
The twins together are a nightmare.
One spreads debuffs, the other buffs their allies and stabilizes everything.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Yikes.
Still, I’d love to have her on our side.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4c51645be8fa9f470b8709c62112e6dd3a23f140.png
Well, that depends on how she feels about me...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
Impressions don’t matter in war.
Just capture her. Everyone's a prisoner after all.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
You’re the scariest one here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/db593cf904047fcd9341f5733e5763ed0d89f03c.png


▼ Charismatic Military Band Musician
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c05831eec5191c66e4d9f07dd546f1030a6a55d3.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
Ohhh. Another charming-silver, different from your father.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
He’s a war survivor. 
A monster, really.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
…The type that’s popular with a certain crowd of girls.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Back to the stage play stuff again?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Yup.
But he carries himself like a gentleman, 
stands tall. You can tell he’s no ordinary person.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png
According to my father, 
they used to be such close comrades you could call them blood brothers.
He’s retired now but remains as a reserve commander.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
What’s that baton for?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
In the old wars, military bands would play music for troops to march in step.
He was the conductor back then.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
Ahh… the Penrose family’s…  line infantry and all that… I get it now.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7b409f3a8778cf91b2d2b52427e700596b567f87.png
He’s seen more war than anyone. 
He’s in a different league.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/72dd97724a630e4534bab4857d221d41037214a9.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png
Ugh, he gives me a really bad feeling with his buffer.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
We need to take him out first. He’s dangerous.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
And he buffs the entire unit. 
This is real bad.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
The only saving grace is that he’s artillery.
I’m cavalry, so I have the advantage. 
Super effective.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
Let’s hope we don’t get caught by the buffed units surrounding him...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png
…Don’t go predicting grim futures like that.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
…I’ve had enough brute force for one day.
Any fun trivia about him...? 
Oh, it says here his instrument of choice is the saxophone.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/86d193f16d1cdf6ac8d2ce23979ddea381f657bd.png
Wonder if he plays in some run-down bar?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
That kind of life’s cool too, honestly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/71864a8437875296ca99c9d5c436c3f439c7e403.png


How was that?

The people introduced this time are sure to use all sorts of tactics to trouble Scarlet and her allies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7e83a0a437aef1140b0d45ae7c48b30693a4e311.png

Across the Empire, you’ll find strategic terrain like the fortress “Great Wall” shown last time, as well as movable bridges over canals, like the one in this map.

With limited forces, how will you establish supply lines and take on powerful enemies?
And will capturing enemy commanders help clear Scarlet’s name?

We hope you’ll look forward to the full story.

Until then, thank you for your continued support of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

notes.title: Director's Message: Regarding the Story of the Game　The Great Prologue ④
notes.content:
Hello!
This is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

We hope you're enjoying The Great Prologue!
We're now in the final stages of development, and we’d really appreciate it if you could wait just a little longer.

Now, let’s have the girls continue with their introductions!
This time, they’ll be talking about the people connected to the "Fortress of the Empire" that stands in Scarlet’s way.

▼The Cool Genius
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bf426c902f83a4eb5299e995cbc596f548ab0d11.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/86d193f16d1cdf6ac8d2ce23979ddea381f657bd.png
A rare sight, a smart one shows up for once.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Weeell...
Apparently, she’s the fire control officer of The Indomitable Great Wall, 
the central fortress defending the Imperial Capital.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
Oh, a fire control officer?
Not only do you need precise rangefinding, 
but you have to predict the target’s future position as well.
A critical role!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
...She really was top of her class at the academy.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png
I figured you’d be skeptical.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
So basically, she’s a master of trajectory calculation.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
Come on, it takes dozens of seconds from firing to impact.
As long as it doesn’t hit, we’re fine.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
You do realize the shockwave alone from a fortress cannon shell can turn a person to dust?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Which also means it’s not exactly nimble.
Well, just watch. I’ll bring her down and blow the viewers’ minds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1ffab17624435c244ed1ee9849d203fae388fe8b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/cce63bc4aa1a7605481965edae37f4ca3a5fefaf.png
...This isn't the kind of artillery I was expecting?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png
Geniuses really are unfair, huh?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a54fb421780d063523b46d35fc2597f6a40ffba7.png
This isn’t something you can just wave off with “genius.”
Stop summoning only the barrel!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7a7b1c92f95c0966679d643cc4e7eea7c7775581.png
Also, why are we the only ones taking damage? 
This just doesn’t sit right.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4c51645be8fa9f470b8709c62112e6dd3a23f140.png
Yeah... hmm...
At this point, I don’t even know anymore, but okay...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
Wow, that pompadour is intense!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/dddc72d63de1e0530c9b80fa3f072674a503bf5c.png



▼ Hot-Blooded Passionate Second Prince
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8e29a98a93169c3c37593114e2cdabd22f829268.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Wow, that pompadour is intense!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
That's not all. Look at his beard.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Wasn’t he the second prince of the Empire?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png
Gwyn’s younger brother, and commander of the Second Division of the Imperial Army.
He’s one of the Empire’s spiritual pillars.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
He’s totally got the face of a villain.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
Does he? That’s just our bias talking.
He’s actually super popular among the citizens and deeply respected.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Really...
So he’s more cheerful and charming normally?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
To put it simply, he’s like the bossy kid on the playground.
He loves big things, strong guys, things like dragons
all the stuff little boys are into.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
That makes so much sense.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
He’s crazy about cavalry too.
Give him a gun and he calls himself a dragoon.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
Super easy to read.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7597f8c9bec6f83b3f2aa5e78bf558814bc3972a.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Is he okay?
He’s acting kinda... too excited?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
He places complete trust in his subordinates and soldiers.
That’s what real charisma looks like.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png
Going up against him feels like...
a total pain, to be honest...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7b409f3a8778cf91b2d2b52427e700596b567f87.png
If father is the Empire’s shield, then His Highness is its spear.
He’s pure frontline power.
Taking him down will be real tough.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2026145c0260718f0ee84c4197b05bc009156d24.png
I’m not really keen on biting into bricks, you know...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/de3db23740d94983eb276b4966b92de841a95632.png



▼ Mysterious Hunter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a907c177ed450dbe8deeb7a09760398082130d18.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a54fb421780d063523b46d35fc2597f6a40ffba7.png
…What the hell is this thing?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
It’s a pink bear.
See? Cute, right?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png
I mean…
Where do I even start?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
It’s our second mascot slot.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/cce63bc4aa1a7605481965edae37f4ca3a5fefaf.png
The first one was Lady Carmine, huh?
That I could at least take in…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Look at those beady little eyes.
Absolutely adorable!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a54fb421780d063523b46d35fc2597f6a40ffba7.png
Stop hitting me with replies I can’t respond to.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
Apparently she’s a hunter from a village near the battlefield.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1634894417fed04d3d247ede5cdcd06192644327.png
Unanimous vote, suspicious individual!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ba2ff26d681a113c33d96afbd72d667a92c65469.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a54fb421780d063523b46d35fc2597f6a40ffba7.png
She just started tossing grenades while singing!?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
The Empire’s terrifying new weapon: A pink bear that throws hand grenades.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1634894417fed04d3d247ede5cdcd06192644327.png
If that’s their new weapon, the Empire’s already doomed!
Wait, what the hell is that thing she’s firing?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/b6b8ed2a8f71dec60994819217e6ef30e6ad2707.png
It’s called a “Sauterelle.” Kind of like a freaky crossbow on steroids.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
That’s not something a hunter should be carrying!!
Wait... She’s not even classified as infantry, she’s artillery!?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
It’s one of the Seven Wonders of the Great Villainess.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c55d447859473f1ef7d8db2f9f6add639f1a3101.png
I’m getting a headache…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
That’s just your brain rejecting reality.
Embrace it...
Embrace the cute...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/107b9adb1c6699ec097cd8e8593044277edd2d14.png



▼ The Second Prince’s Right-Hand Man
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/05ba648a89d1920c9072fca03dbf573bbbd069eb.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
Now that’s a dangerously good-looking guy.
He could totally be the star villain in a play.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0a99973423ed5351439dfde5b61336668e11f534.png
A villain, huh…? I’m not familiar enough with that stuff to say.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/45baa7669f9b76748e5c1746acba81e070552b49.png
You know the kind? The handsome one who does awful things to princesses and goddesses.
Ring any bells?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d48b92dbe10bba51a330dc071712c37df4d78930.png
That’s not something you should be resonating with…
Anyway, this guy’s the logistics officer supporting Prince Ciaran.
The Second Division is stationed in “West Midland,” a breadbasket region.
He handles everything from feed for the cavalry to provisioning the soldiers.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
Let’s see… the cue card says...
He takes care of the prince in both public and private matters.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
Yeah, His Highness isn’t exactly detail-oriented.
Apparently, he needed more looking after than Gwyn did when he was a kid.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9a8b4fe3ba27be930885c2442ced77e2248eb0bd.png
…And this guy’s been looking after him all this time.
Sorry for calling you a villain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ad06f18a5c8e89778f15eae56d92bff9adaa5bcf.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
A rare healer and buffer.
Capture him.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/d751eaa3e605528fa297ee682d5760ae2cd76df4.png
A bit too eager, aren’t we?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3cc3b107191e33bef3a55993c3bc0814fae24f30.png
If you let him act freely, he buffs everyone and becomes a real pain.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/7b409f3a8778cf91b2d2b52427e700596b567f87.png
He needs to go down first.
But he looks pretty well-prepared, so we’ll need to approach carefully.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c02acd2ba607d97af24ae776db742a5e37837f6d.png
…So “carefully” actually exists in your vocabulary, Lady Scarlet?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png
You totally think I’m an idiot... Don’t you?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
Oh no, not at all, no way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/faa5b2684f7d9485578b90c4cd4094d471b115a8.png



How was it?
Today, Scarlet and Lily introduced the members of the Empire’s other military forces standing in their way. The Second Division.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/09a991ddcc79238e92a9c1ea523961aeb35d5387.png

How will Scarlet and her team break through the Empire’s proud “Great Wall Fortress?”
We hope you’ll look forward to finding out when the game launches.

Thank you for your continued support of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!

notes.title: Director's Message: Regarding the Story of the Game　The Great Prologue ③
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
This is the The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily development team.
This is The Great Prologue where Lady Scarlet and Lily-chan introduce characters from the game.
We want to thank everyone for all the comments and feedback.

Let’s continue with the introductions!
This time, we’ll be meeting people connected to Scarlet’s family, the House of Penrose.

Here we go!

▼ The White Angel of Mischief
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2443a5664fa30802883fbe02d39368a347fc6f9e.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8354495730e29fad1b1c26700fb676822460e41a.png
...Is she supposed to be here?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9798bc911aa6e2303560881a70f36eff079ad070.png
She’s definitely not someone meant for the battlefield.
She’s a young lady from the House of Maple, working for my family.
Absolutely smothered with affection by her family, especially her brother, who loves her more than life itself.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18a999e7c751bb044ea356f39080b60f3f5760bf.png
...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a17720eee417cfc1e4841e65669225350d9bd2ef.png
You’re thinking she’s the total opposite of me, aren’t you?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/797baceded6a59d2a6ac0b052136c28ec23216ca.png
Nope! Didn't cross my mind, at all!

notes.content:
Hello! 
This is the development team behind The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.
We hope you enjoyed the first “prologue chat” between Scarlet and Lily!
Thank you again for all your comments and reactions!

▼About the Story
The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily tells the tale of beautiful ladies rebelling against an era and society ruled by men.

It’s a time when women couldn’t pursue their desires freely. When they had to hide their true feelings.
Lily, and many others like her, live under such oppression.
Scarlet, however, is someone who can boldly say “NO” to such a time.

“Those clueless pretty boys need a good beating!”
“I’m the main character here!”
She’s a woman who rebels with everything she’s got.

When Scarlet meets her girl of fate Lily, 
she gains the power of “streaming” and starts a fight with the world itself.

Before they can reach their “happy ending,” enemy commanders will stand in their way.
Whether to use them… or crush them is up to the player.

Who will appear before the two heroines?
Let’s have Scarlet and Lily-chan introduce them.

notes.title: Director's Message: The Great Prologue ① ~ The Story of Two ~
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Did you have a chance to watch the "Bonding Trailer" we released on April 13th?

We’ve received an overwhelming amount of feedback, and we’re truly grateful for all the support.

As we count down to release, we’ll be gradually sharing more about the characters and the story that make this game so special.
And to kick things off—
We’ve invited Lady Scarlet and Lily themselves to help introduce everything to you!

The stage is yours!


▼ The game’s 『Story』


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c8452dcb88dbcfd015a1c6b5bf455101220bfa89.png
…Whoa, whoa, whoa.
Are we seriously letting Lady Scarlet handle this?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/56ae52cb047aa1500745e5b90f5d74f98f9ff230.png
How rude. Who do you think I am?

Let me show you my impeccable public image.
Ahem…
“This is a tale where we use our enemies and totally f—”


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c8452dcb88dbcfd015a1c6b5bf455101220bfa89.png
Stop right there! Don’t say stuff like that!
Hold on a sec— I’ll write a proper script.


——————【Strategy Dogma Ⅰ】——————

"The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily" is a story about
「Scarlet & Lily」leading up to that Happy Ending.

19 enemy commanders stand in their way.
(Including Scarlet and Lily, there are a total of 21 characters in the game.)

At its core, it’s a story about this duo, Scarlet and Lily. Or we could even call them buddies?
Where will their journey ultimately lead them?

This is a story for you to witness that outcome.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/5d8822551af2bb5dbe734b64fa1c02dfb744cfd4.png
(You can view character profiles from the “INFO” menu.)

————————————————————————


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/75b5f5705b34a9b8e473d653c43416821259bbe7.png
Exactly!
Which means we have to clear up that whole “regicide” accusation too, right?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e04fc882a33ce79f16575874db517a6784268cd0.png
Why bother?
We’ll just beat them all down until they… You know?
If they’ve got the guts to cross me, they’d better be ready for the consequences.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/f737b1f250954efdb25c50e21e0a698d12c50722.png
And that’s exactly why people suspect you.
Since I’m getting lumped in with you, can you please act a little more responsibly?


——————【Strategy Dogma Ⅱ】——————

Scarlet stands accused of assassinating the Emperor.
To uncover the truth behind this accusation, will you choose to spare the enemy commanders… or execute them?

The choice lies entirely in your hands.

You may seek out clues and build your army.
Or ignore the suspicions entirely and cut down your foes one by one.

A future where the accusations are cleared… and one where they aren’t.
What form will Scarlet and Lily’s happy ending take?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/5bc7f21b69a123cded7f49189c259ede5dede11f.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3df352145d71c71d84da6f6ca26429a932d1f294.gif
(How Lady Scarlet acts after this… is entirely up to the player.)

————————————————————————

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ed2ba1ca7ac7cf2070d357aab61547105493b456.png
And what’s the point of gathering allies?
Should I just seduce them one by one?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e228563c459e834f33bfb4bc692d8403801324d3.png
Go ahead—if you really think you can do that in front of me.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e04fc882a33ce79f16575874db517a6784268cd0.png
No need to get so jealous.
Don’t worry, You’re the only one for me, Master.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e3a2555eb9503a16dbbb9796cb325fec1d0ae68c.png
Ugh! Quit with the chin thing!
You always dodge issues like this…


——————【Strategy Dogma Ⅲ】——————

This is a story about “Scarlet and Lily’s journey toward a happy ending.”

Rival noblewomen, formidable male adversaries, and even Scarlet’s own family—
many characters will appear before the two.

But at its heart, the story is always about what becomes of “The two.”

There are no branching dialogue choices,
but events will change depending on how you play.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a91e051d467cee6a29c4ed895d057f4bd761eac1.png
Also, be sure to pay attention to the evolving relationships that surround them—
everyday moments shaped by the growing trust of other characters.
We hope you’ll follow their path and witness the future they reach together.

————————————————————————

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/f737b1f250954efdb25c50e21e0a698d12c50722.png
Well, just make sure we do get our happy ending, alright?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bb59e2ce07ecc2b65d4546ee762d2c5dbd10046f.png
If Lily is the one asking, then I’ll make it happen.
A happy ending, just for us.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e15d02d0a4e03e4380da68ffedd53f44d22844a9.png
Yeah…
I’ll be holding you to that.


————————————————————————


I hope you enjoyed the information we presented today

We will be introducing some of the other characters as well from our next message.

We truly appreciate your continued support for “The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.”

Please hang in there just a little longer until the game’s release…!

And now, to wrap things up—
here are the profiles for Lady Scarlet and Lily-chan!

This is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lilly.

As development enters its final stages, the feedback and encouragement we continue to receive through reviews and the Community Hub have been an incredible source of motivation for the entire team. We extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you.

We also received a tremendous response to our previous update regarding "Trust Levels," and the development team is once again deeply grateful for the high level of interest in this title. Thank you so much.

Today we would like to give you a sneak peek of another element from the game to you.
A little introduction to "Scarlet's decision" 

*Please note that the details shared below are based on the current build of the full version and are subject to change as development progresses.


■ Capturing and Executing Enemies

Named characters such as Uisce, who was in the demo, can be captured when using Lily’s skill On the Stage while “Capture Stream” is done on the Stream Airship.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/0d0a2379d659d8a21ea5c3111a0c92d64986115e.png

“Capture Streaming” will be shown when On the Stage is active.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e9595e91e97986b5f1505db0e274a6e98344303d.gif

When you successfully capture them, you can add them as an ally but some enemies need to meet special conditions to capture.
(You can check the conditions for adding an ally from the “UNIT” menu.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2cfe499b5f7b7097d1c05674c1bc396136123472.png

On the other hand, you also have the option to destroy your enemy.
When you choose this, the enemy will not become an ally and will be executed.
“Scarlet’s skills or status can be enhanced” when you choose to execute.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bdbdaf3eaade9ee6d90db4fd6616ea58a8225d90.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/896bf784cb4eb49843e013cb3e84187134994265.png

Depending on the path you choose, there may be different outcomes you will encounter.
Will Scarlet & Lily journey together, alone?
Or will they go forth with new allies…
We hope you enjoy the choices that you make.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/18914ff7695b8228e91473bd9f0c0fda306499f5.png

(When you execute, you may see a different outcome.  Feast your eye on Scarlet's decision!)

■ Regarding the Future of the Demo
At this time, we are fully focused on completing the full version of the game and we will be temporarily pausing updates to the demo.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Additionally, several major changes have been made with the demo, and there are significant differences from the full game.
For this reason, we plan to temporarily suspend distribution of the demo in the near future, with the intent of re-releasing it at a later date with updated content that reflects the full version.
As a substitute during this period, we are currently preparing a gameplay video covering the early stages of the game, which we hope you will enjoy.

We apologize for the inconvenience and truly appreciate your understanding and patience.

We hope you enjoy The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily for the coming days.

Development Team

notes.title: Director Message: Regarding the relationships between characters
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A huge thank you to everyone who played during the Steam Next Fest!

We also truly appreciate all the feedback and reactions to our previous Director's Message. The entire development team is truly grateful for your support.

Today, we’d like to briefly touch on the "Relationship system between characters," which has been a frequent topic in the Community Hub.

Please note that this feature is still in development for the full release, and specifications may change in the future.

Thank you for your continued support!

■ Earning Trust


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e17f35011a807f4b49d1409b6e317f84b40b8b9a.png

First off, we have decided to rename "Relationship" to "Trust" which should better convey the intent of the system.

Some characters can form a trusted relationship with specific allies.
You can check which characters you can build trust with in the Info Menu.
Trust levels increases when "characters fight together and win battles."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/80c8b1014b7a8d861a713f01199f5026c09516ab.png

(The trust progression can be checked on the results screen)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e97f6c97480cbbea495dbdfeadf80f1d5eb1fac9.png

When the trust level between characters reaches a certain point, slice of life stories called "Unite Episodes" will be unlocked.
Each character has unique episodes, ranging from:

- Stories that deepen friendships
- Stories where their beliefs clash
Through these interactions, small but meaningful stories unfold.
(Sorry, no ecchi content in the game!)

Trust-building is not limited to female or male relationships, but please note that not all the stories will be romantic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/39d69e417354d9ada4546fae844f2c4e3ae9d7ac.png

These episodes are divided into multiple stages.
As you progress through these episodes, you will unlock "Unison Skills" that can be used in combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/74539a9a7b4cc43c89934e3b990d5167778add7a.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/35db9876a1b28a780949408ebb79e4929442b9ce.gif
Unison Skills are powerful abilities unleashed through the cooperation of specific character pairs.
Strengthen your characters’ bonds and unleash their full potential!

I hope this clears things up a little!
Thank you again and we hope you look forward to the game!

notes.title: Demo Update Patch v0.1.2
notes.content:
Happy New Year!
We look forward to your continued support in this coming year!

We’re pleased to deliver the “Demo Update Patch v0.1.2 ” we previewed late last year.
Thank you for your patience!

■ Demo v0.1.2 Update Details

- Difficulty Adjustments
　We have rebalanced the difficulty in the demo stage:
　・Adjusted enemy reinforcements and troop types
　・Adjusted elite enemy strength
　・Adjusted boss enemy strength

- Guard Command Added
　When selecting “Command” in battle, you can now choose the “Guard” option.
　・Guard
　　　Reduces incoming damage. If defense is successful, your party’s MP increases more than usual.

- Target Visibility
　A target marker now appears above enemies.
　You can see which character the enemy is aiming at or whether they are using an area-of-effect attack.

- New Tutorial Scene
　A brief tutorial about the new “Guard” and “Target” mechanics has been added.

- Wave Display Revision
　Wave information is now displayed in “x/3” format.

- Story Skip Button Implemented
　A “Skip” button is now available during story scenes,
　which skips the scene until the next player input is required.

- Phase Progress UI Adjustments
　We have updated the UI to clearly show phase progression each turn.

- “On the Stage” Effects Update
　When streaming, if there is a target you can capture,
　the “On the Stage” effects will now change accordingly.

- Application Optimization
　We have optimized the application to improve game startup speed. 

■ Changes to Save Data in Demo Update Patch v0.1.2

Due to these updates, save data from Demo v0.1.1 is incompatible with Demo v0.1.2.
　We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.
　(Older save files will no longer be displayed.) 

In the full release, we plan to continue refining the story, optimizing graphics, and implementing features that are currently missing. We will keep working to improve and expand the game. Please try out “Demo v0.1.2” and share your feedback with us. We’ve been enjoying your gameplay streams and videos—thank you for all your support!

Lastly, here is a small preview of upcoming content still in development.
(Note: Screenshots are from a work-in-progress build and may differ in the final product.)

We appreciate your continued support for “The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.”
Thank you!

notes.content:
Thank you so much for all the feedback, improvement ideas, and supportive messages shared via the Community Hub and reviews. Every message we receive is shared with our development team.

Based on the many suggestions we’ve received, particularly about difficulty and controls, we’ve decided to update the demo to provide a better gaming experience.

■ Demo Update v0.1.2 Details
We plan to release Demo Update Patch v0.1.2 in January 2025.

- Difficulty Adjustments
We will re-tune the difficulty of the demo stages:
・Adjust enemy healing amounts
・Balance enemy spawn frequency and unit types
・Adjust the strength of elite enemies
・Tune boss enemy difficulty

- New "Defend" Command
In battles, the "Defend" option will be added when selecting "Command."
Choosing "Defend" will negate counterattacks and reduce incoming damage.

- Target Visibility
In battles, targeting will now be visualized when issuing commands, making it clearer which enemy you are aiming for.

The full version will include even more improvements beyond these updates. We encourage you to play the demo and share your thoughts with us.

Thank you for your continued support of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!
